limitations.note: Defining the provided RAM again in TopModule.sv creates a duplicate module definition when compiled with the supplied RAM, consistent with the grading compile error.
The rewrite registered both status outputs and gated the RAM enables with reset, changing flag timing and reset-time behavior that the reference fix preserves.
The test compiled against the RAM bundled into the edited file rather than a separately supplied RAM, so it could pass without exposing the duplicate definition.
The scoreboard used the DUT's flags to decide which transfers counted and checked flag values after settling, so it did not detect the changed cycle-by-cycle flag timing.
